# Draft:Theatre releases of Battle for Dream Island

----
Battle for Dream Island is an American animated web series created by twin brothers Cary and Michael Huang. In late 2025, a partnership with specific theatre chains was announced, in which specific episodes from the show would premiere at theatres a day before their YouTube release.
Background
Several screenings were held prior via watch parties that are often titled as the BFDI x II Tours, with the first being held in 2019, and a proper tour being held in 2024. The events are organized by both the creators of Inanimate Insanity and Battle for Dream Island.
The watch parties have been screened in cities across the United States, with examples being such as Chicago, Los Angeles and New York City. In late 2025, it was announced that Jacknjellify partnered with AMC Theatres, alongside Cinemark, and Marcus Theatres to premiere an episode in theatres, which often sold out quickly. After the success of the screening of the episode, many more episodes soon followed.

Episodes
Alone
The announcement for the episode was made in late 2025 following a partnership with AMC. The episode was screened in select AMC, Cinemark and Marcus theatres across the United States on October 16, 2025. The episode was then released to YouTube on the next day. Several screenings were sold out in theatres, and the episode had one million views within nine hours of the upload.
Shattered!
A trailer for the episode was released in November 2025, and this episode premiered in select Marcus and Cinemark theatres across the United States on December 1, 2025. The episode was then released to YouTube on the next day, and a comic book was released alongside on Black Friday.
Insectophobe’s Nightmare 6 and The Three Leg Three-Legged Race
The episode was announced on January 1, and received a poster on January 11. Tickets went on sale on January 16. A trailer was released on January 27, 2026, and it premiered in Cinemark theatres across the U.S on January 29, 2026. A YouTube release came on January 30, 2026. The 5th episode of BFDIE, The Three Leg Three-Legged Race premiered alongside it, and also released on the same day Insectophobe's Nightmare 6 YouTube release.
